g.text: Rollout State: What's Tracked, and Where It Lives
Not a relational schema -- a consensus-backed store, same correctness bar as leader election
Query pattern: 'read the current state of everything, right now' and
'atomically update one instance's state' -- never joins or analytics.
Two controllers must never disagree about which batch is in flight,
the same correctness bar Replication & Consensus needs for a leader.
That's why this is etcd-class (consensus-backed), not a relational DB.
